correctness.rationale: Direct substitution into the first rank-one update gives x2=[((rho+gamma)I-A)b]/(gamma rho), with rho the Rayleigh quotient of b. If gamma is at least L-mu then rho+gamma is at least L, so the shifted Stieltjes matrix is entrywise nonnegative. Conversely for A=diag(mu,L), b=(1,epsilon), the high-curvature coordinate is negative exactly when epsilon squared is below (L-mu-gamma)/gamma. Fresh arithmetic reproduces the package witness rho=8/5 and x2=(13/16,-1/16).
